message:
feat(source): retain original dependent indices through checked field equations

Select the equation backend for admitted constructor signatures whose
result indices are direct fields. Preserve original names, dependent
hypotheses, local aliases and the original major at its actual type.
Unknown function equations remain obligations; no injectivity is assumed.
Keep structural-recursion lowering separate and preserve all annotations.

Promote former capability-refusal fixtures into checked computations and
retain wrong-index child returns as negative tests. Add five source tests,
including generic reconstruction proof dependencies and forbidden erased
annotations. The complete five-package local run reports 1619 top-level
tests, zero failed or ignored; scoped Clippy, workspace compilation and
changed-file formatting pass. Remote gates repeat before publication.
Example checks 20 commands and 8 theorems. Related: fln-qb5, fln-kpd.
